title: a relation the gates refuse still gets its point evaluation, and the refusal is said out loud
note: `bus.seats % 2 == 0` evaluates fine on the numeric surface and is refused by the SMT gates (`%` has no encoding). The literal engine answers it honestly — the point evaluation happened — but the detail names the refusal, because a reader shown only `holds-at-values` cannot tell that no other engine will ever confirm it.
